description: This is a Java test class for the ChangeLogDetective class, containing unit tests to verify its behavior in handling Liquibase changelogs, change sets, and related logic within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ChangeLogDetectiveTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ChangeLogDetective class, verifying its behavior in identifying and managing vintage Liquibase change sets based on filenames, authors, IDs, and change set counts.

methods.name: shouldGetSnapshotVersionsInDescendingOrder
methods.description: Test that the method correctly returns snapshot versions in descending order.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreDisableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Test that change sets with specific IDs are recognized as vintage and ignored.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreEnableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Test that change sets with specific IDs are recognized as vintage and ignored.

methods.name: shouldNotIgnoreDisableForeignKeyChecksForFilenameOtherThanLiquibaseCoreData_1_9_x
methods.description: Test that non-matching filenames cause the method to not consider change sets as vintage.

methods.name: shouldNotIgnoreEnableForeignKeyChecksForFilenameOtherThanLiquibaseCoreData_1_9_x
methods.description: Test that non-matching filenames cause the method to not consider change sets as vintage.

methods.name: shouldNotIgnoreOtherChangeSetFromAuthorNamedBen
methods.description: Verify that change sets authored by 'ben' with other IDs are not considered vintage unless matching specific IDs.

methods.name: shouldExcludeVintageChangeSets
methods.description: Test that vintage change sets are correctly excluded from a list based on their IDs and filename.

methods.name: shouldNotExcludeChangeSetsForFilenameOtherThanLiquibaseCoreData_1_9_x
methods.description: Ensure that change sets are not excluded if filename doesn't match the specific pattern.

methods.name: shouldLogSmallNumberOfUnrunChangeSets
methods.description: Check that the method logs details for small sets of unrun change sets (up to 9).

methods.name: shouldNotLogLargeNumberOfUnrunChangeSets
methods.description: Verify that the method does not log details when there are 10 or more unrun change sets.

methods.name: shouldNotLogUnrunChangeSetsFromOtherChangeLogFile
methods.description: Ensure that change sets from unrelated files do not trigger logging.
